text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government adopts election law providing for a 380-seat assembly.
- Charity restaurants will give 20,000 meals for poor during the Ramadan month.
- National Liberation Front (FLN) leader Boualem Benhamouda says attempts to destabilise his party began in 1988.
- University teachers resume courses after strike over pay.
- Workers' union officials starts meeting to prepare for negotiations over salaries.
- Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf holds talks with his Chinese counterpart Qian Qichen on cooperation.
- Some managers of plastic plants detained over mismanagment.
